chose: The followed teams are a settings namespace of their own, game-teams ({ teams: [] }, every game by default), beside game-feed, not a field of game-feed: the web app PUTs the switch as { following } alone, so a field there would be reset to every game by each flip of the switch. Each pass reads both, so an idle wake is two indexed reads. A game is chosen when either side is named; only a chosen game gets live summaries and wakes the scoreboard (every listed game is still learnt from each read, and the sleep state, pass::Watch, is worked out each pass from what the schedule holds, never stored, so choosing a team takes effect at the next pass).
options: a teams field on game-feed with serde(default), and the web client read-modify-writes the whole value
gray: Where the setting lives is what the web page and the contract harness read; no earlier decision says one lever per namespace or one namespace per feature.
undo: Remove GameTeams from settings.rs and NAMESPACES and the read in game_feed.rs; its stored revisions stay, unread.
